text:
Leah Kim: Quick coordination thread — final loop for candidate Alex Woo is Thursday 11:30am PT onsite + hybrid. Need to lock a few logistics: laptop loaner for a short coding task, single-day visitor parking, and a remote fallback plan in case flight runs late. Can panelists confirm availability?

Omar Singh: I’m available 11:30–12:30 PT. Can do remote if needed.

Maya Chen: 11:30 works for me. Will be remote (travel day).

Carlos Rivera: I can be there in person — should be in by 11:00.

Leah Kim: Awesome, @Omar @Maya @Carlos — thanks. @people-ops can you reserve a laptop loaner (Windows dev image) for Alex from 11:00–14:00 and a one-day visitor parking pass? Candidate will be onsite for ~90 mins. Also, please prep a temporary test account in staging for the exercise with email alias alex.woo+staging@redwood.ai.

people-ops: Confirmed — laptop loaner (Asset tag: LOAN-4721) reserved at Reception. Parking permit printed (lot B, plate still TBD) — we’ll hand it to the candidate when they check in. Test account request noted.

Leah Kim: Thanks. If flight delays, we want a clean remote fallback. Omar & Maya will only be remote; Carlos prefers in-person. Remote fallback plan: 1) move to Zoom link in the calendar 2) Carlos will join remotely if needed 3) candidate does the coding task in their own browser, and we ask them to share screen. OK?

Omar Singh: That’s fine. Do we have a prerecorded environment checklist we can send candidate?

people-ops: We have a short checklist — will DM candidate with VPN instructions, Zoom link, and staging creds. Also will include a link to the lab's Wi-Fi and the reception desk number.

Maya Chen: One more thing — candidate mentioned dietary restrictions (gluten-free). Leah, can we confirm lunch order still?

Leah Kim: Yep — we'll order boxed lunches and mark gluten-free. @people-ops can you add that to the candidate packet?

people-ops: Added dietary note to packet. I’ll also attach a printed NDA for the candidate to sign at reception (standard).

recruiting-bot: Calendar event created: "Alex Woo — Final Loop (Hybrid)" Thu 11:30–12:45 PT. Zoom link + building entry instructions attached.

Carlos Rivera: All good from my side. If for any reason Alex is >20 mins late, let’s ping and decide whether to start remotely or reschedule.

Leah Kim: Agreed. I’ll be point for reschedule if necessary. Thanks everyone — closing loop. :thumbsup:
